introHtml: Custom heart memo office clips bring a touch of warmth to any workspace. Unlike standard office clips, the heart shape adds a friendly, approachable element that works especially well for employee appreciation gifts, Valentine's Day promotions, or healthcare and nonprofit branding. These clips are available in various sizes and colors, and can be imprinted with your logo or message using pad printing or engraving. Choose from magnetic or clip-back styles to suit different surfaces. They're a simple, functional way to show your team or customers you care.
